name: Shimai Intsui ~Houfuku no Renkin Torihiki~
original_name: 姉妹淫墜～報復の錬金取引～
source:
The main character is an alchemist in prison. One day, he meets Mikage, a necromancer. She says, "Can you create a human's body as well?" "Yes. If I could get out of here." "I would like you to create my younger sister's body." "Of course, I can't create anything from nothing." In front of Mikage and Reina, her younger sister, he thinks about something evil....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主角是监狱里的炼金术士。有一天，他遇到了死灵法师御影。她说：“你也能创造出人类的身体吗？” “是的。如果我能离开这里就好了。” “我想让你创造出我妹妹的身体。” “当然，我不可能从无到有创造出任何东西。”当着御影和妹妹丽奈的面，他在想一些邪恶的事情……

[来自工口游戏商店]
